profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary: Skilled IT professional with 12+ years IT experience, in areas of Software Configuration Management and Development, Version Control, Build and Release management, Change management. Well versed with deadline pressures, superior analytical, time - management, collaboration, communication and problem-solving skills. Experience in Build Engineering & Release Management process, including end-to- end code configuration, building binaries & deployments and entire life cycle model in Enterprise Applications. In-depth knowledge of DevOps management methodologies and production deployment Configurations. Skilled at Software Development Life Cycles and Agile Programming Methodologies. Monitor, build and deploy software releases and provide support for production deployments. Experience with Version Control Systems like GIT, SVN (Subversion), TFS. Worked with different Bug tracking tools like JIRA, Remedy, Bugzilla and Splunk. Good Knowledge in developing advanced web-based applications using ASP.Net, C#, JavaScript, Web Services and Databases like Oracle, SQL Server. Ability to quickly understand, learn and implement the new system design, data models in a professional work environment.

company.name: Delaware Department of Technology and Information

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Developed online payroll management software product (https://www.crestpayroll.com ) that manages the entire payroll process including Calculate and Pay Salaries, File Taxes, ACH transactions, E-File, EFT, Worker Compensation, Sales Tax and perform other activities. Developed applications using Visual Studio 2008 and 2010, ASP.NET 3.5 and 4.0, C#, Team Foundation Server and a combination of Windows Services, Web Service, XML, WCF Service Interfaces and ASP.Net Ajax enabled web sites.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Created prototype and production-level object-oriented applications throughout software development lifecycle, including design, modeling, coding, testing, and documentation.	Designed the system to communicate with spa system using the RS485 protocol with Pythagoras board. Designed and developed Install Shield script to install the standalone version of the EA application which will be optimized for the XP and Vista version of the Windows operating system. Designing the data tier along with COM and ADO.NET, business and presentation tiers using C#.NET with MS Visual Studio .NET 2005.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected and developed an ecommerce website for Stone and Tile Shoppe, Inc. (http://www.buystonenow.com/). Used VB.NET, ASP.NET 2.0, SQL Server 2005, Windows Services, and a custom single sign-on.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed applications using Visual Studio 2005, ASP.NET 2.0, C#, Web Service, XML, ASP.Net Ajax enabled web sites. Developed a web based application to offer companies a safe and secures means of disposing of their Electronic Waste including partners with Sellers, Processors, Downstream Vendors and Downstream Recyclers to track the components to resell or to recycle. (http://www.greenstream.net/). Developed an ecommerce website for Audiovox organization’s information including employee’s information, their payroll taxes, and department working and trainee’s information and online purchasing of accessories form AudioVox portals.( http://www.audiovox.com). Developed HTML Website for RCA to display their product information on flash and also showing other information like RCA Televisions, RCA Audio Video, RCA Communications and more. (http://www.rca.com)
